builds.name: nxnative's engine
builds.about: nxnative's tested profile with switch2mac's overlay and key-2 settings: 1.0.0, 1.0.1 or 1.2.1. 60 fps on an M1 Max.

builds.name: MacNativeGames' port
builds.about: ly05010419's MacNativeGames (MIT), its community Wonder port (early): 1.0.0, or 1.2.1 with its update (not 1.0.1); an .nsp needs your firmware for the system fonts. Its own runtime: no switch2mac overlay.

choose.why: nxnative's profile is tested and plays at 60 fps; MacNativeGames' Wonder port is early.
